author: BTCSessions
text:
The past couple months I've been using @freedomiacard - a reloadable visa that I can fund with Bitcoin, use online, or (more importantly) use with tap on my phone (Android). Cost my $60 for the year and I can reload up to $5k USD/mo with no KYC. 

I've used it in 5 countries so far and it's great! Maybe be conservative with the funds you put on if you give a try, just in case anything goes sideways. 

Thanks @KenobiGeneral5 for flagging this for me!

Check it out here 👇

text:
Yes, but remember back around late 2013 or early 2014 - Apple actually banned or blocked a lot of bitcoin wallet apps. 

So even there, there's safety in numbers if lots of people loudly demand the ability to have bitcoin wallets on their phone etc.

text:

It's not MIGHT, these even worse forms of spam have ALREADY been a thing on bitcoin. Whether it's Stamps, BPUB - and these things are unblockable and even worse for nodes.
